caption: The drawing depicts a horizontal rectangular band set against a plain off-white background. The band features a decorative floral and ornamental motif. The primary colors of the band are deep burgundy, with borders of green on the top and bottom edges. Within the band, on the left side, there is a golden oval medallion, framed by two symmetrical clusters of gold leaves that cross at the bottom. On the right side, there are two pink roses with green leaves and small touches of gold foliage around them. The background of the floral and medallion motifs is burgundy with small, evenly spaced purple-pink dots and thin, swirling lines. The composition is horizontally balanced, with the decorative elements spaced evenly apart within the confines of the colored band. The orange-brown and gold accents highlight the floral arrangement and the laurel elements that accompany the central oval shape.
title: Bandbox
